$comment: Part II Section A — form lens for the economic operator identity. All five fields are error-level mandatory per BR-RESP-10, so all required. The identifier scheme agency becomes required once a value is entered (BR-OTH-02 is fatal on the emitted element).
title: Information about the economic operator
description: Identify the economic operator, its role in this bid, and its size.

fields.label: Role in this bid
fields.description: The economic operator's function in this bid (BR-RESP-10-02/03).

fields.label: Official name
fields.description: Official name of the economic operator (BR-RESP-10-05).

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: An identifier that identifies the economic operator (BR-RESP-10-04). The XML @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02) is supplied as a constant 'OP' at export, so there is no separate scheme-agency field.
